pages.title: Rubracium Gauntlets
pages.text: Equip a gauntlet in each hand to charge the throw effect while striking a living target. Repeated hits keep charging it; a short pause releases the target along your look direction. Charging needs at least two food points outside Creative.
A long charge throws harder and can break suitable softer blocks along the target's path. Protection rules still apply. The pair shares durability wear, so keep both gauntlets repaired.
